newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real slips 0.01 pct in bland trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real slips 0.01 pct in bland trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0186 against the greenback in bland trade in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
"The market was very, very quiet today," one trader said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Wednesday surplus of $55 million.
Dealers expected calm to continue in the market on Thursday.
Some also expect a drop in the real-dollar mini-band before the end of the week. The current mini-band was set on Tuesday between 1.019 and 1.24 reais per dollar.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0249 to the dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.037 per greenback, traders said.
